about: The register set we support, measured against vim 9.2 on 2026-11-14 and pinned here so the differential harness keeps comparing us to the real thing. Scope is deliberate (docs/DECISIONS.md): the unnamed register, one-character names with the uppercase append form, `_`, `+`/`*` (one system clipboard, the same implementation) and `=`. NOT here on purpose: "1-"9 and "-" (rotation + small/big classification, measured and then rejected as scope) and `.` (the last-inserted-text register) — the cases that would need them are absent rather than approximated. Every case below only affects the BUFFER through a put, so vim is the reference at runtime; position is not compared because these are about content.

cases.name: a named yank, then a put from that name
a linewise yank appended to itself pastes as two lines
